newsitem.title: FRANCE: Clasquin sets up Netherlands unit.
newsitem.headline: Clasquin sets up Netherlands unit.

text.p: French freight forwarding agents, Clasquin, has set up a subsidiary in the Netherlands, effective June 2.

"The subsidiary, Clasquin Nederland, is based at Amsterdam-Schiphol airport and will specialise in air and sea freight and general logistics activities serving markets in northern Europe, with the exception of Belgium and the UK," a Clasquin official told Reuters.
Clasquin already had units in Italy and Spain as well as a network of overseas offices, the official said.

The Lyon-based agents estimates its 1996 turnover at around 230 million French francs ($39.5 million), up 14 percent on 1995 levels with annual ex-France traffic totalling 10,000 tonnes of airfreight and 10,000 teus, the official added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
